facts: For hydrogen chloride the NIOSH archived table lists these 8-hour recommended protective clothing barriers: Butyl, Teflon, Saranex, Barricade, Responder, Trellchem, Tychem.
For hydrogen chloride the NIOSH archived table lists these 4-hour recommended protective clothing barriers: Neoprene, PVC.
The hydrogen chloride entry includes the hazard language: "Prevent skin contact (solution)/Frostbite."
The hydrogen chloride entry includes the note: "Prevent possible skin freezing from direct liquid contact."
